findings.issue: Clear rejection of a relational candidate with no identifiable target cannot satisfy a universal target requirement without fabricating a target.
findings.resolution: Clear rejection may have no target with target_absence_reason and sufficient context; unresolved missing-context case has separate missing_target_reason. Two synthetic fixture source and anchor hashes match.

findings.issue: Current checker uses flat labels and paragraph status, not nested role decisions and same-paragraph target relations.

limitations: Source extraction was not independently re-audited.
Semantic judgments are contestable and examples are development material.
No agreement gain, reader benefit, runtime implementation, or adopted catalogue is established.
